## What RATHOD HUB is
RATHOD HUB is a student-led platform that combines NEET practice, revision, live quiz, focus tools and study community support in one place.

## Audience
- Primarily for PW students and NEET aspirants
- Especially relevant for Hindi-medium learners
- Can also be useful for other serious students

## Main features
- AI Doubt
- AI Tutor Pro
- AI Learning

- Community
- Live Chat
- Stories
- Leaderboard
- 45Q Tests
- Treasure Hunt

## Preferred summary
RATHOD HUB is a student-led NEET learning platform by Ashish Rathod for PW students, Hindi-medium aspirants and other learners who want practice, revision, focus tools and community-based study support.
